Problem.title: Preparing for Germany shouldn't feel like guesswork.

scattered.title: Scattered courses
scattered.body: German on one app, coding on another, visa tips in a WhatsApp group. Nothing connects, and nothing tells you what to learn next.

guidance.title: No honest guidance
guidance.body: Agents with something to sell and forums full of outdated posts. It is hard to find someone who has actually made the move and will tell you how it went.

path.title: An unclear path
path.body: Which German level do you need for a visa, a job or a university place, and in what order? Without a plan, months slip by.

Faq.title: Questions, answered.
Faq.more: Something else? <kazzy>Ask Kazzy</kazzy> or <contact>write to us</contact>.

cost.a: Each course has a one-time price in Naira, shown on the course page. You keep access to the course after you pay. The first lesson of every German course is free to try.

transfer.q: Can I pay by bank transfer?
transfer.a: Yes. You can pay by card or by bank transfer to our Nigerian account. Your course unlocks as soon as the transfer is confirmed.

certificate.a: You receive a Multivate certificate of completion for every course you finish. It shows your progress but does not replace official exams such as Goethe or telc, which we help you prepare for.

levels.a: German A1 and A2 today, plus tech skills courses. B1 is in development.

language.q: What language are the courses taught in?
language.a: Lessons are explained in English, with German used more and more as you progress.

mentors.a: Mentors are people from Nigeria who live in Germany. Once you are enrolled, you can message them through Multivate about study, work and daily life.

FinalCta.title: Your move to Germany starts with one lesson.
FinalCta.body: Create a free account, try the first German lesson, then decide.
